svg.text: Five distinct styles · clichés stripped · one design system

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Neon Monogram, stripped
svg.desc: A lowercase neon m and a single cyan terminal dot. No glass tile, no HUD ticks, no status LEDs, no progress rail. A cyan halo behind an off-white core.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Brutalist Mark concept
svg.desc: A deconstructed lowercase m: three deliberately unequal legs under a single hard header, with the cyan centre leg punching through it. Counters kept narrower than the stems so the letter still reads at a glance. Flat, asymmetric, two colours, no effects.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Glass Tiers concept
svg.desc: The design system's three glass elevation surfaces drawn as a flat cascading stack: #0d1117, #111620 and #161c27, rimmed green, cyan and amber. No glow, no cube, no gradient.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Signal Pulse concept
svg.desc: An oscilloscope trace that resolves into a bold M, with a live charge running the wire between green and amber terminals. A telemetry-first mark for a builder whose work is always live.

svg.title: maithresh.sh — Contribution Mosaic concept
svg.desc: A contribution-graph lattice where a subset of cells resolves into a squared m. Flat squares only: no connecting lines, no glowing nodes, no travelling charge. Green and amber mark the two endpoints.
